explanation: Two unrelated triggers: (1) the comma or colon after a city name in a list of cities/places ("Paris, New York[,] Vienna", "Sydney, Melbourne[,] Bangkok", "London, England[:]"); (2) in math, the last digit just before a closing parenthesis of a factor or argument ("(x-[1])", "2(1, [1])", "(x+[2])"). A few other strong excerpts ("up-to-date", "at the University", "she is today") fit neither.
